identificationModule.briefTitle: Nab-P+Cb+PD1 Inhibitors as Neoadjuvant Therapy for Early TNBC
identificationModule.officialTitle: Nab-P+Cb+PD1 Inhibitor Neoadjuvant Therapy for Early TNBC: a Single Center, Non Blinded, Randomized Phase II Clinical Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: We plan to explore the efficacy and safety of albumin-bound paclitaxel+carboplatin+Camrelizumab in neoadjuvant therapy for early TNBC patients, optimize the administration method and drug combination therapy.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This study is a single center, non blinded, randomized phase II clinical trial. A total of 64 TNBC patients are planned to be enrolled. Patients who meet the inclusion criteria will be randomly divided into two groups (Group A and Group B) at a ratio of 1:1, and stratified according to T stage and N stage. The administration regimen is as follows: Group A： albumin-bound paclitaxe (260 mg/m²,d 1)+Carboplatin (AUC=5, d 1)+Camrelizumab (200 mg, d 1), 21 days as one cycle, 6 cycles; Group B: albumin-bound paclitaxe (125 mg/m²,d 1,8,15)+Carboplatin (AUC=5, d 1 )+Camrelizumab (200 mg, d 1), 21 days as one cycle, 6 cycles

Primary endpoint: Pathological complete response rate (pCR rate).

Secondary study endpoints: Objective response rate (ORR), event free survival rate (EFS), disease-free survival (DFS), distant disease free survival (DDFS), and safety.

Exploratory endpoints: Differences in efficacy and immune microenvironment under different administration methods

primaryOutcomes.description: Pathological Complete Response (pCR) rate: It refers to the absence of any invasive cancer in the resected specimens (breast + axilla) after completion of neoadjuvant chemotherapy and surgery (i.e., ypT0/is, ypN0).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 1 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate (ORR) based on RECIST v1.1 assessment, defined as the number of target lesion responders evaluated by MRI/ultrasound;

EFS is defined as the time from randomization to any of the following events: disease progression, local or remote recurrence, second primary malignant tumor (breast cancer or other cancers) or death caused by any reason during neoadjuvant treatment;
DFS is defined as the time from surgery to any of the following events: local or distant recurrence, or death for any reason;
The time from surgery to distant recurrence or death for any reason;
Evaluate the nature, incidence, and severity of adverse events according to CTCAE 5.0.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After each cycle of chemotherapy (21 days as 1 cycle)]

otherOutcomes.measure: Association of the tumor microenvironment with treatment response
otherOutcomes.description: Multiple immunofluorescence: CD3+CD4+PD1+KI67; CD3+CD8+PD1+KI67; GZMB; TCF-1; CD31; NG-2 in tumor tissue.

otherOutcomes.measure: Association of peripheral blood lymphocyte subsets and cytokines with treatment response
otherOutcomes.description: Flow cytometric assessment of peripheral blood lymphocyte subsets: CD3+CD4+PD1+KI67; CD3+CD8+PD1+KI67 and Detection of peripheral blood cytokines: vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), angiopoietin-2 (ANG-2), basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF), transforming growth factor-β1 (TGF-β1), and endostatin (ES)
